attestations.text: HUNG Jên-kan 洪仁玕 (known in Western sources as "Hung-Jin", original ming 謙益 H. 吉甫), Feb. 18 or 20, 1822–1864, Nov. 23, a native of Hua-hsien, Kwangtung, was prime minister and regent of the Taiping Kingdom.
